description: PNG/BMP image toolkit — pure LOOK, no native code and no external service. Decodes PNG (carries its own RFC-1951 inflate), resizes, crops, and re-encodes to PNG or exports to BMP. For small-to-medium images: logos, icons, thumbnails, QR/graphics. Not JPEG (a JPEG codec isn't practical in pure LOOK). Verified against Pillow.
author: codlook
